desc.en: A not too high quality metal made from mixing various ores. It's not very strong, and not popular due to how easily it deforms, but it can be obtained cheaply.
desc.ja: さまざまな鉱物を混ぜ合わせたあまり質の良くない金属。強度も低く、変形しやすいためあまり好まれないが、安く手に入る

desc.en: Effect: Selecting this property increases the item's effect power by 10％.
desc.ja: 効果：調合の潜力選択時に選択すると、アイテムの効力を１０％上昇させる

desc.en: Increases transfer PP by 5 when this item is used as a material in Synthesis.
desc.ja: この潜力のついた材料を使って調合すると、引き継ぎＰＰ枠が５増加する

desc.en: Causes armor to increase maximum HP. Effect: Maximum HP increases by 10.
desc.ja: 防具に最大ＨＰを上昇させる効果を付与する。効果：最大ＨＰが１０上昇する
